page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m1.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.u2a family. It features 2 dedicated AMD EPYC vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 2.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per vCPU. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with the instance.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:1 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-leaning entry-level option. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without the performance variance associated with shared-core environments, offering a predictable hardware profile for lightweight workloads such as basic web serving, microservices, or utility tasks.
